notes:
Improved
• Closing the window hides Solis to the tray icon (bottom right of the taskbar) instead of quitting.
• While it's hidden, edits keep going, tonight's queue keeps editing, revisions finish, and Premiere stays connected.
• Click the tray icon, or open Solis from the Start menu, to bring it back. Right-click the tray icon to quit.
• The first time you close it, a notification tells you Solis is still running.
• To make closing quit Solis, turn off Settings > Keep Solis running when closed. An edit in progress still finishes first.
• Fixed Solis sometimes not opening again after closing (it stayed in Task Manager).
